description: SP.composer: resolveComposition(request, catalog) over core's pack catalog. Each case gives the request (recipe, world, game pack choices, engine) and either the composition it resolves to (expected) or the refusal code (expectedError.code: a CompositionError or GenreResolutionError code). Generated by npm run pack-composition-corpus; see docs/system-packs.md.

cases.name: combat on thistlecombe (gate-decides, off)
cases.claim: Living world leaves combat to the world: switching it on installs combat and vitals, but Thistlecombe's features.combat is false, so combat does not run and nothing is overridden.

notes.detail: 'combat' is installed but features.combat is off, so it does not run
the recipe leaves features.combat to the world

cases.name: combat ranged with no world (gate on)
cases.claim: With the adventure settings (features.combat true) the ranged variant runs and writes combatStyle ranged.

notes.detail: the recipe leaves features.combat to the world

cases.name: combat parameters
cases.claim: A tuning parameter is kept on the pack without touching the genre; one outside its range is refused and dropped.

refusals.detail: 'combat' parameter 'criticalChance': 2 is outside [0, 1]
'combat' has no parameter 'nope'

notes.detail: the recipe leaves features.combat to the world

cases.name: survival needs and stamina parameters (P9c)
cases.claim: Switching survival-needs on installs stamina and vitals with it (its requires); neither is gated by a genre feature, so all three run; a parameter in range is kept on its pack and one outside its range is refused and dropped.

refusals.detail: 'survival-needs' parameter 'globalDamageMultiplier': -1 is outside [0, inf]

cases.name: gathering, fishing, farming and crafting parameters (P9d)
cases.claim: Switching fishing and farming on installs gathering with them (their requires; farming's time-weather is already in the preset); none of the three is gated by a genre feature, so all run. Crafting stays the world's to decide (the recipe's gate-decides; this world has no crafting). A parameter in range is kept on its pack and one outside its range is refused and dropped.

refusals.detail: 'farming' parameter 'defaultGrowth': 0 is outside [1, inf]

notes.detail: 'crafting' is installed but features.crafting is off, so it does not run
the recipe leaves features.crafting to the world

cases.name: traversal and vehicles on the village, combat still off (P9e)
cases.claim: Switching traversal and vehicles on in Thistlecombe's living world: neither is gated by a genre feature, so both run once their requires (controls) does; combat is untouched and stays the world's to decide (off). A parameter in range is kept on its pack and one outside its range is refused and dropped.

refusals.detail: 'traversal' parameter 'upFactor': 0 is outside [1, inf]

cases.name: npc life, presentation and ambient animals on the village (P9f)
cases.claim: Thistlecombe's living world runs npc-life and npc-presentation as base packs; switching ambient-animals on runs it once npc-life does. Parameters in range are kept on their packs; a greeting chance above one in a million million and a negative door spacing are refused and dropped.

refusals.detail: 'npc-life' parameter 'greetingBasePpm': 2000000 is outside [0, 1000000]
'npc-life' parameter 'doorMinSpacingMm': -1 is outside [0, inf]

cases.name: dialogue and social on the village, combat still off (P9g)
cases.claim: Thistlecombe's living world already presets dialogue (server); switching social on runs it once dialogue does, and neither is gated by a genre feature. The provider variant auto is kept; combat is untouched and stays the world's to decide (off). A parameter in range is kept on its pack and one outside its range is refused and dropped.

refusals.detail: 'social' parameter 'romanceJealousyFloor': -1 is outside [0, inf]

cases.name: language learning on the village, combat still off (P9h)
cases.claim: Switching language-learning on runs it once dialogue and quests do (Thistlecombe's living world presets both); no genre feature gates it. A parameter in range is kept on its pack and one outside its range (a pass score over 100) is refused and dropped. Combat is untouched and stays the world's to decide (off).

refusals.detail: 'language-learning' parameter 'identificationPassScore': 101 is outside [0, 100]

cases.name: progression on the village, combat still off (P9i)
cases.claim: Switching progression on runs it on Thistlecombe's living world, whose genre has experience on; its hud and saves dependencies are base packs. A parameter in range is kept on its pack and one outside its range (a streak cap below 1.0x) is refused and dropped. Combat is untouched and stays the world's to decide (off).

refusals.detail: 'progression' parameter 'streakCapTenths': 9 is outside [10, inf]

cases.name: strategy with the strategy pack
cases.claim: Strategy's own pack needs business-sim, shops and inventory; the strategy genre has no inventory, so shops does not run, nor business-sim, nor strategy (requires-inactive on each).

refusals.detail: 'shops' requires 'inventory', which does not run (features.inventory is off), so 'shops' does not run
'business-sim' requires 'shops', which does not run (it requires a pack that does not run), so 'business-sim' does not run
'strategy' requires 'business-sim', which does not run (it requires a pack that does not run), so 'strategy' does not run

notes.detail: 'inventory' is installed but features.inventory is off, so it does not run

cases.name: strategy with the strategy pack and inventory
cases.claim: Switching inventory on is the composer writing its gate: features.inventory true, and the chain runs.

cases.name: puzzle with combat
cases.claim: Combat needs inventory and the puzzle genre has none: combat does not run (requires-inactive), so its gate write is withheld, features.combat stays off and the activation does not gain the combat module.

refusals.detail: 'combat' requires 'inventory', which does not run (features.inventory is off), so 'combat' does not run

notes.detail: 'inventory' is installed but features.inventory is off, so it does not run
'combat' is installed but features.combat is off, so it does not run
'combat' does not run, so its variant, parameter and gate choices are not applied

cases.name: puzzle with combat and inventory
cases.claim: Switching inventory on too lets the chain run: the composer writes both gates, and the activation gains the combat and equipment modules the puzzle genre does not select.

cases.name: combat variant without combat
cases.claim: A variant for a pack that is not installed is refused (not-installed) and is not a change on the preset line.

refusals.detail: 'combat' is not installed, so its variant, style and parameters do nothing; switch it on first

cases.name: rpg-adventure without inventory
cases.claim: Switching off a preset pack another pack requires is refused (shops requires inventory): the pack stays, and the refused change is not counted.

refusals.detail: 'inventory' cannot be switched off: 'shops' requires it

cases.name: rpg-adventure without shops and inventory
cases.claim: Switching off shops and then inventory removes both, and the composer switches features.inventory off.

cases.name: foundation cannot be switched off
cases.claim: An always-on pack refuses to be switched off.

refusals.detail: 'foundation' is always on and cannot be switched off

refusals.detail: the pack index has no pack 'jetpacks'

cases.name: platformer seen from behind
